findings.summary: If the retired-memory listing fails after SyncCards has already written pages, SyncCardsProject returns MemoryUnavailable and skips the index rebuild and the sync-completed record.
evidence: SyncCardsProject returns at lines 229-231 on CardRunFailure(patchErr) == MemoryUnavailable, before RebuildIndex (line 239) and RecordSyncCompleted (line 245).
SyncCards runs before PropagateCards (line 212), so promoted pages may already be on disk.

findings.summary: The walk visits every retired memory that has a page on every run and counts it as patched, so run and dry-run counts do not tell whether anything changed.
evidence: The visit callback appends to report.Patched after patchPage returns nil (propagate_cards.go:32-37).
eachCardPatchTarget has no check that the page already matches the target status.

findings.summary: A memory restored to active after its page was patched is absent from ListRetiredMemories, so its page keeps the stale status.
evidence: ListRetiredMemories selects only status in (superseded, archived) (store.go:154).
eachCardPatchTarget visits only memories from that list (propagate_cards.go:71, 87).
Read propagate.go, propagate_cards.go, sync_cards.go (PlanCards, walkCards, SyncCardsProject), store.go listing, cmd_sync.go, card.go scan and update paths.
Engram Propagate uses the shared patchPage/savePatched with the same message formats; only frontmatter_hash moves, as R-030/R-033 require.
No frontmatter-only or body-hash defect found. No tests run.
